items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: I take this fellow with me to the Birdland for two week engagement. It was a big hit.

ctx.x: So to make the whole story short, then I'm supposed to go abroad to (THROUGH THE STATE DEPARTMENT inaudible). This when I got my lesson. I turn around, and they took Doc Cheetam from my band (inaudible).
